_help: Every ingredient, tool and dish in Kitchenria lives in this file.
id      : short unique name used by recipes.json (lowercase, underscores, no spaces).
type    : 'ingredient' (raw basics), 'tool', 'prep' (in-between steps like dough) or 'dish'.
starter : true if the player owns it from the very beginning.
tags    : moods used by visitors later, e.g. warm, sweet, savory, baked, drink, fresh, breakfast.
art     : how the doodle is drawn. 'shape' picks a drawing (see js/shapes.js), 'color' / 'accent' / 'fill' tint it,
'top' adds a topping (specks, pat, sparkle, heart, dots, steam) in 'topColor'.
To use your OWN picture instead, add  "image": "art/items/my-picture.png"  inside art.
